meta.name: Pezzy Design DNA
meta.description: AI-native anime streaming platform. Cinematic dark UI in the HBO Max lineage — deep navy-to-black, spotlight-lit heroes, vertical poster cards — with an AI/anime signature layer: immersive WebGL hero, selfie-to-avatar 3D reveal, playful staggered card motion on recommendation rows, and a black-on-black anime-glyph profile backdrop.
source_references: HBO Max home (primary vibe: navy-black, centered nav, spotlight hero) — liked
Paramount+ home (vertical cards, 'Your Next Watch' rows)
Diagonal capsule pattern (density/scale reference for profile backdrop — smaller & subtler than this)

primary.role: brand navy / primary CTA, focus rings, active nav — the HBO navy lineage

secondary.role: steel-blue accent — CTA edges, focus, hover glow; used consistently across chat, 'talk to your homepage', and generative affordances rather than a separate cyan

accent.role: anime energy pink — sparingly on badges (NEW EPISODE), highlights, secondary glow in gradients

neutral.usage: Darkest two are page/base backgrounds; mid values are card and elevated surfaces; #9AA0BE is muted/secondary text; #EEF0FA is primary text (never pure white on pure black).

color.contrast_strategy: Deep near-black base with content (posters, key art) as the brightest thing on screen. UI chrome stays low-contrast and recedes; accents glow rather than fill. Text uses off-white #EEF0FA to avoid harsh pure-white-on-black shimmer.

font_families.heading: Fraunces (variable serif, editorial display) — fallback: Georgia, serif

typography.font_style_notes: An editorial serif (Fraunces) carries hero titles and section headings — tight tracking, confident weight, a warmer counterpoint to the navy-steel palette — paired with Satoshi for Latin body copy and UI and Assistant for Hebrew. Overline used in ALL-CAPS for row labels and eyebrow tags ('YOUR NEXT WATCH', 'RECOMMENDED FOR YOU'). Streaming apps lean on the poster art for personality, so type stays disciplined.

spacing.content_density: comfortable — generous around the hero, tighter within card rows
spacing.section_rhythm: Large gap (64–96px) below the hero; consistent 40–48px vertical rhythm between content rows; 12–16px gutters between cards inside a row.

layout.grid_system: Full-bleed hero + horizontally-scrolling card rails. Rails overflow the right edge (peek of next card) to signal scrollability, HBO/Paramount style.
layout.max_content_width: none for hero (full-bleed); rows extend edge-to-edge with left padding aligned to content start (~4–6vw)
layout.columns: Fluid — ~6 vertical cards visible at 1440px, responsive down to ~2.5 on mobile
layout.alignment_tendency: centered top nav (HBO Max), left-aligned hero copy, left-aligned row labels

shape.border_usage: none by default; a 1px translucent white border (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)) appears on hover/focus of cards and on glass surfaces
shape.divider_style: avoid hard rules; separate sections with spacing and subtle background-value shifts

elevation.shadow_style: soft diffused + colored glow on interactive/accent elements

levels.high: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), plus optional accent glow e.g. 0 0 40px rgba(124,92,255,0.25)

elevation.depth_cues: color intensity + blur/glass + spotlight glow behind hero art (not literal drop shadows on flat UI)

iconography.preferred_set: Lucide (or Phosphor) for UI; custom anime-glyph set for the profile backdrop only

motion.easing: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) (easeOutExpo-ish) for entrances; cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for standard transitions
motion.entrance_pattern: fade + slight upward translate (16–24px) with per-item stagger on rows; scale-from-0.94 for cards
motion.exit_pattern: quick fade + slight scale-down, faster than entrance (~160ms)
motion.philosophy: cinematic and intentional — motion reinforces the AI 'your homepage is composing itself for you' story. Playful on card reveals, calm everywhere else. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

components.button_style: Primary: solid violet #7C5CFF, pill or 10px radius, medium weight label, subtle glow on hover. Secondary: frosted-glass (blur + rgba(255,255,255,0.1)) like HBO's 'MORE INFO'. Play button often a circular icon button.
components.input_style: dark filled #111320, 10px radius, inner 1px translucent border, steel-blue focus ring
components.card_style: Vertical poster (2:3), 10px radius, no chrome at rest; on hover: scale ~1.06, lift, 1px translucent border, reveal title/meta/quick-actions overlay from bottom gradient
components.navigation_pattern: centered horizontal top nav, logo center or left, search + profile right; becomes translucent-glass on scroll, transparent over hero at top
components.modal_style: centered, frosted-glass backdrop (blur + dim), 16px radius, content-detail modals slide/scale in
components.list_style: horizontal scroll rails with an eyebrow/overline label; personalized rows carry a thin navy accent bar beside the label instead of a badge
components.component_notes: Signature element: personalized rows get a small navy accent bar and animate their cards in with a stagger when they enter viewport or when the row is (re)generated by the recommendation engine.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a dark theater where the screen (content) is the only light source — plus a faint neon pulse of anime culture underneath
aesthetic.era_influence: modern streaming (2024+ HBO Max) crossed with neo-Tokyo neon accents
aesthetic.genre: premium entertainment streaming with an anime/AI-native twist

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents — glows, the anime-glyph backdrop, AI chips; no heavy decoration
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous negative space (pure black) as a design element; lets posters and glows breathe
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: content-forward — key art dominates, UI recedes
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero focal point per screen, then progressive reveal down the rails
visual_language.contrast_level: high between content and background, low within UI chrome
visual_language.texture_usage: near-none on flat UI; textured only in the WebGL hero and the profile glyph backdrop

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast + luminance (bright content on dark) + spatial isolation of the hero
composition.balance_type: asymmetric (left-weighted hero copy, right-weighted key art)
composition.flow_direction: top-down then left-to-right through horizontal rails
composition.grouping_strategy: labeled horizontal rails, each a themed/personalized cluster
composition.negative_space_role: primary — the black is the stage, not empty space to fill

imagery.photo_treatment: full-bleed cinematic key art with a spotlight glow behind the subject and a bottom/left gradient scrim for text legibility
imagery.illustration_style: flat line anime glyphs for the profile backdrop; AI-generated stylized anime avatars for profiles
imagery.graphic_elements: soft radial glows, gradient scrims, subtle grain, neon edge lighting
imagery.pattern_usage: black-on-black anime-glyph tile on the profile/auth screens, center-out fade

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate, tactile — cards respond on hover with scale+glow, buttons press and glow
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: poster scales up ~1.06, lifts, reveals title/meta/quick-actions; neighbors optionally ease aside slightly
interaction_feel.transition_personality: smooth glide with a confident ease-out; card row reveals are playful/staggered
interaction_feel.loading_style: shimmer skeletons in surface tones; AI generations show a cyan pulsing state ('composing your row…')
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: moderate — concentrated on cards, CTAs, and AI moments; calm elsewhere

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: warm, personal, in-the-know — it talks like it actually knows your taste
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct + inviting ('Play', 'Ask Pezzy', 'Make me a row about…')
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: conversational and generative — offers to build/recommend rather than showing a dead end
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: calm, human, never blames the user

overview.effect_intensity: moderate overall, heavy-immersive on hero and avatar reveal
overview.performance_tier: heavy (WebGL/Three.js) for hero + avatar; medium/lightweight (CSS/Framer Motion) everywhere else
overview.fallback_strategy: reduce to CSS/static: WebGL hero falls back to a static key-art image + CSS glow; disable particle/scroll effects under prefers-reduced-motion or on low-end devices
overview.primary_technology: React Three Fiber (Three.js) for 3D; Framer Motion for UI motion; CSS/SVG for the profile backdrop

background_effects.type: mesh-gradient + soft spotlight glow behind hero key art
background_effects.description: Deep navy-black base with a large soft radial glow (violet→cyan, low opacity) positioned behind the hero subject, subtly drifting. Optional very-low-opacity animated grain over the whole page.
background_effects.technology: CSS radial-gradients + optional WebGL for the drifting mesh in the hero

params.density: sparse — one or two glow sources

particle_systems.description: Optional sparse drifting light motes in the hero depth to add life without distraction. Off on reduced-motion.
particle_systems.technology: React Three Fiber points, or lightweight Canvas 2D fallback

params.movement_pattern: slow upward drift with gentle noise

3d_elements.description: TWO signature 3D moments. (1) HERO: an immersive WebGL scene behind the featured title — parallax depth, drifting glow, subtle camera sway responding to cursor; key art composited in front. (2) AVATAR REVEAL: the selfie-to-anime-avatar result reveals with a 3D card/portal — a glowing ring, depth, and a cyan bloom as the generated avatar materializes and can be rotated/tilted.

params.renderer: WebGL (Three.js via R3F), dpr-capped for perf
params.lighting: low-key with a violet key light and cyan rim light
params.camera: subtle mouse-parallax sway; shallow FOV for cinematic depth
params.materials: physically-lit for avatar, emissive glows for accents
params.geometry: avatar plane/portal ring + depth layers; hero uses layered planes/parallax
params.interaction_model: cursor-parallax on hero; drag-to-rotate/tilt on avatar reveal

shader_effects.description: A dissolve/materialize shader for the avatar generation ('developing' from noise into the finished anime portrait), plus optional subtle animated gradient in the hero glow.

params.fragment_output: noise-driven reveal mask + emissive edge glow at the dissolve boundary

parallax.depth_range: subtle — hero only, a few % translate

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: each content rail as it enters viewport (~top 85%)
scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: staggered scale-in + fade-up of cards (THE signature row reveal)
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: play-once on enter (not scrubbed), so it feels like the row 'composes itself'

scroll_morphing.description: not used — keep scroll behavior legible for a content browse experience

text_effects.description: Hero/feature titles fade-up with slight tracking-in; optional violet→cyan gradient fill on key headings and the Pezzy wordmark. Row labels are static.

cursor_effects.description: Primary CTAs and card quick-actions have a subtle magnetic pull toward the cursor. No global custom cursor (keeps a familiar streaming feel).

params.interaction_zone: primary CTAs, play buttons, avatar tiles

image_effects.type: hover reveal + parallax-tilt on poster cards
image_effects.description: Poster cards scale/lift on hover, reveal a bottom-gradient info overlay, and get a very slight 3D tilt toward the cursor. Optional subtle rgb-shift/glow edge on focus for a premium feel.

params.filter_pipeline: slight brightness up on hover, neighbors slightly dim
params.hover_transform: scale 1.06, translateY -6px, rotateX/Y up to ~4deg toward cursor
params.reveal_animation: info overlay fades/slides up from bottom scrim

glassmorphism_neumorphism.description: Nav bar on scroll, secondary buttons ('More Info'), and detail modals use frosted glass over the dark base — matches HBO Max's translucent chrome.

canvas_drawings.description: The profile/auth screen backdrop: a tiled field of small black-on-black anime-culture glyphs (shuriken, torii, onigiri, sword, ramen bowl, manga sparkle, speed-lines, sound-effect katakana), spaced like image #5 but MUCH smaller and lower-contrast, with a center-out radial fade (visible near center, dissolving to pure #05060A at edges) so it never competes with the avatars. Can be a static tiled SVG with a radial-gradient mask, or a Canvas/WebGL version with a faint slow shimmer on a few glyphs.
canvas_drawings.technology: SVG <pattern> + CSS radial mask (default); optional Canvas 2D for subtle shimmer

params.animation_loop: optional — a few glyphs faintly twinkle (very slow); static is fine
params.color_scheme: glyphs in #0F1118 → #1A1D2B (barely above #05060A base), highlights rarely up to #272B3D
params.responsiveness: tile scales with viewport; mask always centers on the avatar cluster

svg_animations.description: Pezzy wordmark/mark can path-draw on first load or auth; AI 'thinking' states use a small looping SVG pulse in cyan.

params.filter_effects: soft cyan glow on AI states

visual_effects.composite_notes: Effect budget is deliberately front-loaded: the WebGL hero and the avatar-reveal are the two 'wow' moments and justify Three.js; everything in the browse experience (rows, cards, nav, modals) is Framer Motion + CSS so it stays 60fps and cheap. The signature interaction is the staggered card reveal on recommendation rails — it should read as 'the AI is composing this row for you,' reinforced by a cyan AI chip on personalized rows. The profile-screen glyph backdrop is the brand's quiet anime signature: present, ownable, but subordinate to the avatars via the center-out fade. All heavy effects degrade to static/CSS under prefers-reduced-motion and on low-end devices.
